# I Prompted It For You

> The "Let Me Google That For You" of the AI era. Type someone's question, get a shareable link, and when they open it they watch the question being typed and are sent to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, Copilot, Le Chat or DeepSeek.

- Home: https://iprompteditforyou.com/
- Link format: https://iprompteditforyou.com/?q=<url-encoded prompt>&ai=<chatgpt|claude|gemini|perplexity|grok|copilot|lechat|deepseek>
- Free, no account, no server-side storage, open source: https://github.com/0l1v3rr/iprompteditforyou.com
